_meta.note: Community guides — each renders at /guides/<slug> from guides/view.html. Members are matched live from the directory by category (exact) and keyword (substring against name/category/keywords/tagline). Each guide has a featured-placement slot 'guide:<slug>' managed in Admin → Sponsorships. Optional (Oct 2026): `sections` [{id,title,blurb,members:[slug],categories}] render curated groups that also auto-add members in `categories`; `ask` adds a scoped Ask Wendy box; `deals` shows member offers from businesses in the guide; `related` lists sibling guide slugs.

guides.title: Senior Living & Resources
guides.lede: Trusted senior care, living communities, and support services across the West Valley.
guides.intro: The West Valley is one of Los Angeles' most senior-friendly communities — home to nationally recognized retirement communities, in-home care agencies, and advocacy organizations. Every provider listed here is a Chamber member business, accountable to our community.
guides.lede_es: Cuidado de mayores, comunidades de vida asistida y servicios de apoyo de confianza en todo el West Valley.
guides.intro_es: El West Valley es una de las comunidades más amigables para los adultos mayores de Los Ángeles — hogar de comunidades de retiro reconocidas, agencias de cuidado en casa y organizaciones de defensa. Cada proveedor aquí es un negocio miembro de la Cámara, responsable ante nuestra comunidad.

guides.title: Health, Spas & Wellness
guides.lede: Hospitals, medical practices, spas, fitness, and wellness professionals in the West Valley.
guides.intro: From world-class hospitals like UCLA Health and Providence Cedars-Sinai Tarzana to neighborhood spas, chiropractors, and fitness studios — the West Valley is a healthcare and wellness hub. Find a Chamber member provider below.
guides.lede_es: Hospitales, consultorios médicos, spas, fitness y profesionales del bienestar en el West Valley.
guides.intro_es: Desde hospitales de primer nivel como UCLA Health y Providence Cedars-Sinai Tarzana hasta spas, quiroprácticos y estudios de fitness del vecindario — el West Valley es un centro de salud y bienestar. Encuentre un proveedor miembro de la Cámara abajo.

guides.title: Home Improvement & Services
guides.lede: Contractors, plumbers, electricians, landscapers, and home pros you can trust.
guides.intro: Hiring for your home is easier when the business is a Chamber member — local, established, and invested in this community. From full remodels to a single repair, start here.

guides.title: Entertainment & Things To Do
guides.lede: Theatres, events, recreation, and fun across the West Valley and Warner Center.
guides.intro: There's more to do in the West Valley than ever — live theatre, bowling, golf, wine tastings, and event pros who can turn any occasion into a memory. All Chamber members, all local.
categories: Party Equipment Rental - Special Events Consultants
guides.lede_es: Teatros, eventos, recreación y diversión en el West Valley y Warner Center.

guides.title: Schools & Education
guides.lede: Schools, tutoring, child care, and adult education in the West Valley.
guides.intro: The West Valley's schools — public, private, and specialty — are a major reason families put down roots here. These Chamber member schools and education services serve every age.
guides.lede_es: Escuelas, tutorías, cuidado infantil y educación para adultos en el West Valley.
guides.intro_es: Las escuelas del West Valley — públicas, privadas y especializadas — son una de las razones por las que las familias echan raíces aquí. Estas escuelas y servicios educativos miembros de la Cámara sirven a todas las edades.

guides.intro_es: Anclado por Westfield Topanga & The Village — uno de los principales destinos de compras del país — y rodeado de comercios especializados que no encontrará en ningún otro lugar. Compre local, compre con miembros.
